tagline.en: A customer spent exactly 100 and got no discount

story.zh: 大促当天，客服群炸了：有人买了两件只收了一件的钱，还有人刚好凑满 100 却没减。测试是红的。
story.en: It's sale day and support is on fire. Someone bought two items and paid for one. Someone else hit exactly 100 and got nothing off. The tests are red.

goal.zh: 让 Qoder 找到 bug 并修好，测试全绿。不许改测试。
goal.en: Have Qoder find and fix the bugs until every test is green. Don't touch the tests.

openingPrompt.zh: 跑一下 node --test，看看哪些测试挂了，告诉我原因。先别改
openingPrompt.en: Run node --test, see which tests fail, and tell me why. Don't fix anything yet

hint.zh: 按回车发送，看 Qoder 怎么定位问题。
hint.en: Press Enter, then watch Qoder track the problem down.

prompt.zh: 修掉这些 bug，只改 src，不要动测试文件，修完再跑一遍测试
prompt.en: Fix the bugs. Only change src, leave the test files alone, then run the tests again

label.zh: 测试文件没被动过手脚
